reference.title: Scenario 9 — Image linked rather than embedded
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document where the author has inserted an image using the Link to File

section.p: Consider a document where the author has inserted an image using the Link to File option rather than embedding the image data in the .docx file. Linked images display in Word only when the linked file is accessible on disk. The image data is not stored inside the .docx archive, so the converter cannot extract it.

table.title: Image linked instead of being embedded

row.entry: [Image linked to external file — not embedded in .docx archive]

entry.codeblock: <!-- Output A: broken reference --> <image href="media/MISSING_image.png"/> <!-- Output B: image silently dropped -->

section.p: Result:Linked images produce either a broken <image> reference or are silently dropped. Always embed images before submission. This issue is specific to Microsoft Word; Google Docs, LibreOffice, and WPS Office.
section.note: Embed every image directly in the document body, apply meaningful alt text for accessibility, and add a caption to every figure that requires a title in the published output.
